_comment: Region-specific pain points and personas (ids prefixed in_/eu_/us_). Keyword patterns drive the no-key classifier (first 3 matches, in order, within the document's region).

categories.name: Health claims rejected (PED, non-disclosure)
categories.description: Claims denied for pre-existing disease, non-disclosure or 'not medically necessary'.

categories.name: Cashless denied & TPA delays
categories.description: Hospitals and TPAs refusing or delaying cashless; discharge waits.

categories.name: Room-rent limits, co-pay & sub-limits
categories.description: Proportionate deductions from room-rent caps, co-pays, disease sub-limits.

categories.name: Motor claims, surveyors & garages
categories.description: Surveyor delays, depreciation deductions, garage disputes, IDV.

categories.name: LIC, ULIP & endowment mis-selling
categories.description: Low-return policies pushed by agents and banks; surrender losses.

categories.name: Premium hikes with age & renewal
categories.description: Steep renewal increases, especially for senior citizens.

categories.name: Grievances, ombudsman & Bima Bharosa
categories.description: Escalations to insurer GRO, Insurance Ombudsman, IRDAI Bima Bharosa.

categories.name: Car insurance premiums rising
categories.description: Renewal quotes up 30–50%, young-driver prices.

categories.name: Renewal price-walking & loyalty penalties
categories.description: Existing customers quoted more than new ones.
keywords: renewal|loyalty penalty|price walking|auto[- ]renew|cheaper for new customers

categories.name: Home claims: flood, subsidence & leaks
categories.description: Escape-of-water, flood and subsidence claims disputed or slow.

categories.name: Travel insurance claims
categories.description: Medical, cancellation and baggage claims refused.

categories.name: Pet insurance exclusions & premiums
categories.description: Pre-existing exclusions, premiums rising with age.

categories.name: Slow claims & loss adjusters
categories.description: Claims dragging on, adjusters low-balling.

categories.name: Financial Ombudsman & complaints
categories.description: FOS cases, final responses, compensation.

categories.name: Private medical & German PKV/GKV costs
categories.description: Private medical insurance premiums, PKV rises, GKV contributions.

categories.name: Health claim denials & prior authorization
categories.description: Prior-auth denials, 'not medically necessary', out-of-network bills.
keywords: prior auth|not medically necessary|claim denied|denial|out of network|appeal

categories.name: ACA marketplace premiums & subsidies
categories.description: Premium increases, subsidy changes, plan choice.

categories.name: Auto insurance rate hikes
categories.description: Premiums up sharply without claims.

categories.name: Home policies dropped (wildfire, hurricane)
categories.description: Non-renewals in CA, FL and elsewhere; FAIR Plan, Citizens.

categories.name: Low-ball offers & adjuster disputes
categories.description: Adjusters undervaluing claims, total-loss disputes.

categories.name: High deductibles & copays
categories.description: Deductibles and out-of-pocket costs too high to use cover.

categories.name: Medicare Advantage networks & denials
categories.description: Narrow networks, prior auth, plan switching.
